title: Vegetables, fruit, grains, herbs, spices, sweeteners and other plant pantry items
notes: Confirmed WP3 policy: alternative flours do not inherit wheat flour; each follows its source ingredient because catalog flour denotes ordinary wheat flour and gluten safety is handled separately.
Confirmed WP3 policy: use group:allium for onion, garlic, shallot, leek, green onion and chive so one household exclusion can cover the allium family.
Confirmed WP3 policy: hot fresh chillies and chilli-based powders inherit chili_pepper; bell_pepper and black_pepper do not.
Confirmed WP3 policy: garlic_salt, onion_salt, celery_salt and seasoned_salt inherit salt because a household avoiding salt would avoid these blends.
Confirmed WP3 policy: individual berry varieties inherit berries.

Extract policy: almond, citrus, mint, coconut, rum, vanilla and other commercial flavour extracts may contain alcohol as a solvent; pandan extract evidence is a Southeast Asian grocery flavouring and is treated as non-alcoholic.

Packaged seasoning policy: use may_contain only where the catalog evidence or customary product directly supports meat or seafood; generic spice-only packets remain unlinked when composition is not evidenced.
accepted_by remains null until the package owner personally reads and accepts every drafted entry.

almond_extract.reason: Recipes use concentrated almond extract; natural versions derive almond flavour and commercial extracts may use alcohol solvent.

asian_seasoning.reason: The sole recipe gives only a generic Asian seasoning label, with no evidence of a particular meat, seafood or plant base.

bonito_flakes.reason: Dried bonito flakes are made from skipjack, a tuna species, and the catalog has tuna as the nearest fish family id.

cheese_tortellini.reason: The recipe explicitly uses frozen cheese-filled tortellini, so a guest avoiding cheese would avoid this pasta.

coconut_extract.reason: Measured coconut extract supplies concentrated coconut flavour and commercial versions may use an alcohol-based solvent.

coconut_flavoring.reason: The recipe names bottled coconut flavoring; it may use coconut-derived flavour and may carry an alcohol solvent.

dashida.reason: The recipe identifies Dashida as Korean beef-flavoured roasted salt, a beef seasoning avoided by guests excluding beef.

egg_noodles.reason: This catalog id covers egg and Hokkien noodles; egg is a defining dough ingredient under the confirmed egg-food policy.

jasmine_flavoring.reason: The recipe gives an unspecified commercial jasmine flavoring, which may use alcohol as the aromatic carrier.

kimchi.reason: Prepared cabbage kimchi commonly contains fish sauce or fermented shrimp, although explicitly vegan batches exist.

lemon_extract.reason: Recipes measure lemon extract as concentrated lemon flavour; commercial extracts commonly use alcohol as the carrier.

marshmallow.reason: Conventional large and miniature marshmallows commonly use gelatin, while vegetarian formulations also exist.

milk_chocolate.reason: Milk chocolate is a finished confection, not a form of milk; dairy safety remains the allergen and diet rules' responsibility.

mint_extract.reason: The recipe uses measured mint extract; it concentrates mint flavour and commercial extracts may contain alcohol solvent.

nasi_goreng_spice_mix.reason: Packaged nasi goreng seasoning may include dried shrimp or shrimp paste, although brands and homemade spice mixes vary.

orange_extract.reason: Recipe evidence includes orange extract and orange oil; both concentrate orange flavour, while extract may use alcohol solvent.

pandan_extract.reason: The waffle recipes use Southeast Asian grocery pandan extract as concentrated pandan liquid, with no recipe evidence of alcohol.

pho_spice.reason: The recipe identifies a packet sized for broth but provides no evidence that the pho spice packet itself contains meat.

rum_extract.reason: Rum extract is concentrated rum flavour rather than rum itself, but commercial extracts may retain an alcohol carrier.

stuffing_mix.reason: Evidence includes explicitly chicken-flavoured boxed stuffing alongside herb-seasoned mixes, so chicken is possible but not universal.

vanilla.reason: Nearly all evidence writes vanilla extract; it derives flavour from vanilla beans and commercial extract commonly contains alcohol.

vanilla_bean.reason: Whole split vanilla pods are the raw spice, not the catalog's alcohol-prone vanilla extract; the extract instead inherits the bean.

white_chocolate.reason: White chocolate is a finished cocoa-butter confection with no chocolate family id and does not inherit milk under policy.

adobo_seasoning.reason: Recipe evidence uses an all-purpose peppered adobo seasoning blend, not a food with one dependable ingredient parent.

agave.reason: Agave nectar is a distinct plant syrup, and the catalog provides no broader syrup or agave plant parent id.

allspice.reason: Whole and ground allspice are forms of one standalone spice, not a mixture with a catalog parent.

almond_flour.reason: The evidence alternates almond meal and almond flour; both are ground almond, not the catalog's ordinary wheat flour.

almond_milk.reason: Unsweetened almond milk is a beverage made from almonds and is not dairy milk under the confirmed policy.

anise.reason: Recipes use both star anise and anise seed under this broad spice id, with no narrower shared catalog parent.

annatto.reason: Annatto seed and powder are forms of the same standalone colouring spice without another catalog family id.

apple.reason: Fresh sliced, diced and whole apples make this the family root for apple-derived catalog ingredients.

apple_pie_spice.reason: Apple pie spice is a dry cinnamon-led spice blend used to season apples; it does not contain apple itself.

applesauce.reason: Unsweetened and ordinary applesauce are cooked purées made principally from apples.

apricot.reason: Fresh and dried apricots are the same fruit family and have no broader catalog parent.

arrowroot.reason: Arrowroot powder and starch are a standalone plant starch with no matching source-plant or starch family id.

artichoke.reason: Whole artichokes and canned or marinated hearts form this vegetable family without another catalog parent.

arugula.reason: Fresh arugula leaves are a distinct leafy vegetable and no other catalog id represents its family.

asian_pear.reason: Asian and Korean pears in the recipe evidence are crisp cultivated varieties of pear.

asparagus.reason: Fresh trimmed asparagus spears are a distinct vegetable family with no suitable catalog parent.

avocado.reason: Whole ripe avocados and their flesh make this the root id for avocado-derived products.

baguette.reason: French baguettes and banh mi loaves in the evidence are long crusty varieties of bread.

baking_chocolate.reason: Unsweetened, semisweet and German baking chocolates share this root, and no generic chocolate id exists.

baking_powder.reason: Baking powder is a standalone chemical leavener rather than a form of another catalog ingredient.

baking_soda.reason: Baking soda or soda is a distinct alkaline leavener with no suitable ingredient parent.

bamboo_shoot.reason: Fresh and canned sliced bamboo shoots form a distinct vegetable family in the catalog.

banana.reason: Fresh, sliced and mashed bananas form the family root for edible banana-fruit preparations.

banana_leaf.reason: Banana leaves are cooking wrappers from the plant, not the edible banana fruit represented by the banana id.

barley.reason: Pearl and cooked barley are forms of this standalone cereal grain without a broader catalog parent.

basil.reason: Fresh and dried basil leaves make this the root herb id for named basil varieties.

bay_leaf.reason: Whole and crumbled bay leaves are a distinct culinary herb with no other catalog family id.

bean_sprouts.reason: Evidence includes generic and mung bean sprouts, so no single bean source is guaranteed by this id.

beet.reason: Fresh, cooked and canned beetroot are forms of one root-vegetable family.

bell_pepper.reason: Green, red and other sweet capsicums are bell peppers, not the hot chili_pepper family under the confirmed policy.

berbere.reason: Berbere is an Ethiopian red-pepper spice blend used in explicitly spicy dishes, so chili pepper is a defining base.

berries.reason: Generic recipe lines explicitly allow raspberry, blackberry or blueberry, making berries the family root.

bilimbi.reason: Bilimbi is a distinct sour tropical fruit used whole, with no suitable broader catalog parent.

biscuit_dough.reason: Refrigerated canned biscuit dough is a prepared dough product without a biscuit or dependable flour parent id.

biscuit_mix.reason: Bisquick and generic baking mix are compound prepared mixes with no single dependable catalog parent.

bitter_melon.reason: Sliced ampalaya or bitter melon is its own gourd vegetable and has no generic melon parent id.

black_pepper.reason: Ground peppercorn is black pepper, botanically and culinarily distinct from hot Capsicum chilli peppers.

blackberry.reason: Frozen blackberries are a named berry variety under the confirmed berries policy.

blueberry.reason: Fresh and frozen blueberries are a named variety within the catalog's generic berries family.

bok_choy.reason: Baby and mature bok choy or pak choi form a distinct leafy vegetable family.

bread.reason: Sliced white, wheat and French loaves make bread the catalog root for bread-derived foods.

bread_flour.reason: Strong bread flour is a high-protein wheat flour used to make bread, not a product made from bread.

bread_mix.reason: White bread mix is a dry preparation used to make bread, rather than bread itself or a product made from it.

breadcrumbs.reason: Fresh, soft, seasoned and dry bread crumbs are all produced from bread.

broccoli.reason: Broccoli heads, florets and broccolini uses make this the root id for broccoli preparations.

broccoli_slaw.reason: Prepared broccoli slaw and broccoli coleslaw mixes are shredded predominantly from broccoli stems.

brown_rice.reason: Cooked and uncooked whole-grain brown rice are a direct variety of rice.

brown_rice_flour.reason: Brown rice flour is ground whole-grain rice and a rice-flour variety, not ordinary wheat flour.

brown_sugar.reason: Light and dark packed brown sugar are direct varieties of the generic sugar family.

brussels_sprouts.reason: Whole, halved and shredded Brussels sprouts form their own brassica vegetable family.

buckwheat.reason: Whole buckwheat used for blini is a distinct pseudocereal with no matching catalog parent.

bulgur.reason: Recipe evidence identifies bulgur as cracked wheat, but the catalog has no wheat family id to record that ancestry.

burdock_root.reason: Whole gobo or burdock root is a distinct root vegetable without another catalog family id.

buttered_breadcrumbs.reason: Every use explicitly calls for bread crumbs prepared with butter, so both components are defining.

butternut_squash.reason: Whole and cubed butternut squash are a named winter-squash variety.

butterscotch_chips.reason: Packaged butterscotch chips or morsels are a standalone confection with no butterscotch family id.

cabbage.reason: Green, napa and generic shredded cabbage make this the root id for cabbage-derived foods.

cajun_seasoning.reason: Cajun and Creole seasoning blends commonly include cayenne or paprika, though brand recipes vary.

cake_flour.reason: Sifted cake flour is a fine low-protein variety of ordinary wheat flour.

calamansi.reason: Whole calamansi used for juice are a distinct small citrus fruit without a matching catalog parent.

canned_tomatoes.reason: Canned diced, chopped and stewed tomatoes remain preserved forms of tomato.

cantaloupe.reason: Fresh cubed cantaloupe is a distinct melon fruit with no generic melon family id.

caramel.reason: Caramel sauce and dulce de leche share this confection id, with no single dependable ingredient parent.

caraway.reason: Whole and ground caraway seed form a standalone spice family.

cardamom.reason: Whole pods, crushed seeds and ground cardamom are forms of one independent spice.

carrot.reason: Whole, sliced, grated and shredded carrots make this the root id for carrot products.

cassava.reason: Fresh cassava, manioc and yuca roots are the same standalone starchy vegetable.

cauliflower.reason: Whole heads and florets form the cauliflower vegetable family without a broader catalog parent.

cayenne.reason: Cayenne and crushed hot red-pepper flakes are dried forms of hot chili pepper.

celeriac.reason: The evidence calls celeriac celery root, a root-form variety of celery.

celery.reason: Fresh stalks and chopped celery make this the family root for celery forms.

celery_salt.reason: Celery salt is a seasoning made from salt and celery flavour; both exclusions should cover it.

celery_seed.reason: Whole celery seed comes from the celery plant and is covered when a household excludes celery.

cellophane_noodles.reason: Recipe evidence repeatedly identifies cellophane noodles as mung-bean or bean-thread noodles.

cereal_cornflake.reason: Crushed and whole corn flakes are a breakfast cereal made principally from corn.

cereal_rice.reason: Rice Krispies and generic crisp rice cereal are prepared principally from rice.

chayote.reason: Sliced chayote is a distinct squash-like vegetable without a generic gourd parent id.

cherry.reason: Fresh, dried, candied and maraschino cherries form one fruit family in this catalog.

chickpea_flour.reason: Chickpea flour is finely ground chickpea and is not the catalog's ordinary wheat flour.

chili_pepper.reason: Fresh red, Thai and long chillies make this the root family for hot Capsicum products.

chili_powder.reason: Measured chilli powder is a dried ground chili-pepper seasoning under the confirmed hot-pepper policy.

chinese_five_spice.reason: Chinese five-spice powder is a compound spice blend without one defining catalog parent.

chipotle_pepper.reason: Dried chipotle is a smoked ripe jalapeño and therefore a hot chili-pepper variety.

chives.reason: Fresh chopped chives are an allium herb; the confirmed allium group will be added through its required separate change.

chocolate_chips.reason: Dark and semisweet chocolate chips are a standalone confection because no generic chocolate id exists.

chocolate_syrup.reason: Bottled chocolate sauce is a flavoured syrup variety used as a sweet topping.

chow_mein_noodles.reason: Chow mein, thin Chinese and pancit canton noodles share this prepared-noodle id, but no generic noodle parent exists.

cilantro.reason: Fresh cilantro and coriander leaves are the same standalone culinary herb.

cinnamon.reason: Ground cinnamon is a distinct spice and the root for no narrower catalog hierarchy.

cloves_spice.reason: Whole and ground culinary cloves form one standalone spice id.

cocoa.reason: Unsweetened cocoa powder is a distinct cocoa solid with no cacao or chocolate parent id.

coconut.reason: Fresh flesh, grated and flaked coconut make this the root id for coconut-derived foods.

coconut_cream.reason: Coconut cream and cream of coconut are concentrated coconut products, not dairy cream.

coconut_flour.reason: Coconut flour is ground dried coconut and is not ordinary wheat flour under the confirmed policy.

coconut_milk.reason: Canned coconut milk is extracted from coconut flesh and is not dairy milk.

coconut_sugar.reason: Coconut or coco sugar is a sugar variety produced from coconut-palm sap.

coleslaw.reason: Prepared coleslaw is a shredded cabbage salad, so cabbage is its defining vegetable base.

coleslaw_mix.reason: Packaged coleslaw mix is raw shredded cabbage and vegetables used to make slaw, not prepared coleslaw itself.

collard.reason: Collard, turnip and mustard greens share this broad leafy-greens id without a single narrower parent.

coriander.reason: Recipe evidence mixes coriander seed, ground coriander and fresh leaves, so the id cannot safely inherit the leaf-only cilantro entry.

corn.reason: Fresh ears and canned or frozen kernels make corn the root id for corn-derived foods.

corn_flour_masa.reason: Masa harina is treated corn flour used for pupusas and tamales, not the catalog's ordinary wheat flour.

corn_syrup.reason: Light and dark corn syrups are syrup varieties produced from corn starch.

cornmeal.reason: Yellow and ordinary cornmeal are coarse meals milled from dried corn.

cornstarch.reason: Cornstarch is the purified starch produced from corn and would be avoided with a corn exclusion.

couscous.reason: Plain couscous is a wheat pasta grain product, but the catalog has no wheat or generic pasta family id.

cracker_crumbs.reason: Ritz, graham and generic cracker crumbs vary by cracker type, and no cracker family id exists.

cranberry.reason: Fresh and dried cranberries are a named berry variety under the confirmed berries policy.

cream_of_tartar.reason: Cream of tartar is powdered potassium bitartrate used in baking, not dairy cream.

creamed_corn.reason: Cream-style and creamed corn are prepared predominantly from corn kernels and their pulp.

croutons.reason: Plain, toasted and seasoned croutons are cubes made from bread.

crystallized_ginger.reason: Candied and crystallized ginger are pieces of ginger preserved with sugar.

cucumber.reason: Fresh English, pickling and ordinary cucumbers make this the root cucumber id.

cucumber_pickle.reason: Dill, sweet and sliced pickles in the evidence are preserved cucumbers.

cumin.reason: Whole, ground and powdered cumin make one standalone spice family.

currant.reason: Dried currants are the preserved form of a named berry variety.

curry_leaf.reason: Fresh and dried curry leaves are a distinct aromatic herb, not curry powder.

curry_powder.reason: Curry powder is a variable spice blend that often includes ground chilli but is not guaranteed to do so.

daikon.reason: Daikon, Korean radish and muwoo share this root-vegetable id; no generic radish parent exists.

dark_chocolate.reason: Chopped dark chocolate is a standalone confection because the catalog has no generic chocolate family id.

date.reason: Fresh, Medjool and dried dates form their own fruit family rather than only the generic dried-fruit class.

dill.reason: Fresh and dried dill weed make this the root herb id for dill forms.

dill_seed.reason: Dill seed is the culinary seed form of the dill plant and inherits a household dill exclusion.

dinner_roll.reason: Dinner, hoagie, Kaiser and sweet rolls in the evidence are small bread varieties.

dried_fruit.reason: Generic dried and mixed dried fruit is produced from unspecified fruits, so the broad fruit id is the safe parent.

dried_mushroom.reason: Dried button and other mushrooms remain preserved forms of mushroom.

dried_onion_flakes.reason: Dried minced onion and onion flakes are dehydrated forms made directly from onion.

dried_shiitake.reason: Dried shiitake and dried black mushrooms are named varieties within the dried-mushroom family.

dry_mustard.reason: Dry mustard and mustard powder are the powdered seed form of the mustard family.

durian.reason: Whole durian is a distinct tropical fruit without a broader catalog family id.

eggplant.reason: Eggplant or aubergine is a nightshade vegetable and has no relation to egg despite its English name.

english_muffin.reason: Toasted English muffins are griddled bread rounds and inherit the bread family.

fennel.reason: The evidence mixes fennel bulbs and ground fennel under this family-level plant id.

fennel_seed.reason: Whole and crushed fennel seeds are the culinary seed form of fennel.

fenugreek.reason: Whole and ground fenugreek seeds form the root id for this spice plant.

fenugreek_leaf.reason: Dried fenugreek leaves are the herb form of the same fenugreek plant.

fig.reason: Fresh and dried figs form a distinct fruit family with no suitable catalog parent.

flour.reason: Plain and all-purpose flour in the evidence is ordinary wheat flour and is the root for its direct wheat-flour varieties.

food_coloring.reason: Optional liquid food colours span several colours and formulations without a dependable food parent.

french_fried_onions.reason: Fried onion flakes and fried onions are prepared directly from onion.

frozen_bread_dough.reason: Frozen Italian, French and pizza bread dough is the unbaked form of bread and is covered by a bread exclusion.

fruit.reason: Generic fresh fruit lines explicitly allow several berries, making fruit the broad catalog family root.

gai_lan.reason: Trimmed gai lan or Chinese broccoli is a distinct leafy vegetable with no exact catalog family parent.

galangal.reason: Fresh sliced galangal rhizome is a standalone aromatic seasoning distinct from the catalog ginger id.

garam_masala.reason: Garam masala is a variable compound spice blend without one defining catalog ingredient parent.

garlic.reason: Fresh cloves and crushed garlic are members of the confirmed allium household-exclusion family.

garlic_powder.reason: Garlic powder is dehydrated, ground garlic and inherits garlic and allium exclusions.

garlic_salt.reason: Garlic salt combines garlic and salt; the confirmed policy places it under both ingredients.

ginger.reason: Fresh gingerroot and ground ginger make this the family root for ginger preparations.

glutinous_rice.reason: Sticky, sweet and glutinous rice are named varieties of rice despite containing no gluten.

gnocchi.reason: The evidence explicitly includes fresh potato gnocchi, a dumpling made principally with potato.

gochugaru.reason: Korean red chilli powder and flakes are dried ground hot chili pepper.

golden_syrup.reason: Golden syrup is a named sugar-cane syrup variety used interchangeably with corn syrup in one recipe.

grape.reason: Fresh red, green and seedless grapes form the root id for grape-fruit preparations.

grape_leaves.reason: Canned grape leaves are cooking wrappers from the vine, not the grape fruit represented by the grape id.

grapefruit.reason: Whole and ruby grapefruit segments form a distinct citrus fruit family without a generic citrus parent.

green_beans.reason: Green, string and French-style beans share this vegetable id without a generic bean parent.

green_chili.reason: Fresh and canned green chillies are direct hot chili-pepper varieties.

green_onion.reason: Green onions, scallions and spring onions are young onion forms and inherit onion's allium ancestry.

green_papaya.reason: Green papaya is the unripe vegetable-use form of papaya and remains covered by a papaya exclusion.

grits.reason: Grits are a coarse cooked cereal milled from corn.

guava.reason: The sole recipe uses guava leaves rather than fruit, and no broader leaf or guava-family parent exists.

habanero_pepper.reason: Very hot fresh habaneros are a direct variety of hot chili pepper.

hamburger_bun.reason: Hamburger and sandwich buns are bread rolls; the word hamburger does not make the bun a ham product.

hash_brown.reason: Frozen shredded hash browns are a prepared potato product.

herbes_de_provence.reason: Herbes de Provence is a multi-herb seasoning blend without one dependable catalog herb parent.

hominy.reason: Hominy is alkali-treated whole corn and remains a corn-derived grain product.

honey.reason: Measured honey is a standalone bee-produced sweetener with no suitable ingredient parent.

hot_dog_bun.reason: Hot-dog buns are split bread rolls and do not contain or inherit the hot dog served inside.

ice.reason: Ice cubes and crushed ice are the frozen physical form of water.

instant_mashed_potato.reason: Instant potato and mashed-potato flakes are dehydrated products made from potato.

italian_seasoning.reason: Italian seasoning is a variable dried-herb blend without one defining catalog herb parent.

jackfruit.reason: Fresh sliced jackfruit is a distinct tropical fruit with no suitable catalog family parent.

jaggery.reason: Jaggery is an unrefined cane or palm sugar and belongs to the generic sugar family.

jalapeno.reason: Fresh, minced and pickled jalapeños are a named hot chili-pepper variety.

jerk_seasoning.reason: Jamaican jerk seasoning commonly contains Scotch bonnet or other hot chilli, though prepared blends vary.

jicama.reason: Peeled and chopped jicama is a distinct root vegetable without another catalog family id.

kabocha.reason: Kabocha is a named winter-squash variety used in chunks, slices and soup.

kaffir_lime_leaf.reason: Kaffir lime leaves are an aromatic herb from the tree, not the lime fruit represented by the lime id.

kale.reason: Fresh chopped and torn kale leaves form their own leafy-vegetable family.

kiwi.reason: Fresh kiwi pulp, slices and diced fruit form a distinct fruit family.

leek.reason: Fresh leek whites and stalks are a direct member of the confirmed allium household-exclusion group.

lemon.reason: Whole lemons and wedges make this the root id for lemon juice, zest and extract.

lemon_juice.reason: Fresh and bottled lemon juice is pressed directly from lemons.

lemon_pepper.reason: Lemon-pepper seasoning uses dried lemon peel or lemon flavour with pepper, so lemon is a defining component.

lemon_zest.reason: Grated lemon peel, rind and zest are taken directly from lemon fruit.

lemongrass.reason: Fresh stalks and prepared lemongrass are a distinct aromatic herb unrelated to lemon fruit.

lettuce.reason: Iceberg, leaf and generic salad lettuce make this broad leafy-vegetable id.

lime.reason: Whole limes and wedges make this the root id for lime juice and zest.

lime_juice.reason: Freshly squeezed and measured lime juice is made directly from limes.

lime_zest.reason: Grated lime peel and zest are taken directly from lime fruit.

long_grain_wild_rice_mix.reason: The packaged mix explicitly combines long-grain rice and wild rice, so both named grains are possible components.

lychee.reason: Canned sliced lychees are a distinct tropical fruit without a broader catalog parent.

lye_water.reason: Kansui is an alkaline cooking solution used to change noodle texture, not plain water for household exclusions.

macaroni.reason: Cooked and dry elbow macaroni form a pasta family, but the catalog has no generic pasta parent id.

mace.reason: Ground mace is the culinary aril from the same fruit that yields nutmeg and follows that spice family.

mango.reason: Fresh, diced, sliced and puréed mango make this the root mango-fruit id.

maple_syrup.reason: Pure and light maple syrup are named varieties of the generic syrup family.

marjoram.reason: Fresh and dried marjoram are forms of one standalone culinary herb.

mashed_potatoes.reason: Prepared homemade and instant mashed potatoes are made principally from potato.

meat_tenderizer.reason: Unseasoned meat tenderizer is an enzyme or seasoning applied to meat and does not itself contain meat.

millet_flour.reason: Finely ground millet flour is a non-wheat grain meal, but the catalog has no millet parent id.

mint.reason: Fresh chopped mint leaves make this the root herb id for mint-derived flavourings.

mixed_herbs.reason: Generic mixed herbs combine cilantro, mint, basil and other herbs, so no single parent is dependable.

mixed_vegetables.reason: Frozen, fresh and stir-fry vegetable mixes vary across many vegetables and have no single safe parent.

molasses.reason: Dark and ordinary molasses are concentrated by-products of cane-sugar refining and follow a sugar exclusion.

msg.reason: Monosodium glutamate and Accent are a standalone flavour enhancer with no suitable catalog parent.

mung_bean_starch.reason: The sole recipe explicitly calls this mung-bean flour or starch, made from mung bean.

mushroom.reason: Fresh button, portobello and generic mushrooms make this the root mushroom id.

mustard_seed.reason: Whole mustard seed is the seed form of the mustard plant and follows a mustard exclusion.

nori.reason: Toasted nori, kim and laver are explicitly dried seaweed varieties.

nutmeg.reason: Whole grated and ground nutmeg make this the root id for the nutmeg spice fruit.

oat_bran.reason: Oat bran is the bran fraction milled from oats and follows an oats exclusion.

oats.reason: Quick, rolled and steel-cut oats form the catalog's root oat-grain family.

okra.reason: Fresh whole and sliced okra pods form a distinct vegetable family.

old_bay.reason: Old Bay is a compound seasoning that commonly includes paprika or red pepper, though the exact blend is proprietary.

olive.reason: Green, black and ripe whole olives make this the root olive-fruit id.
